Okayyyy FaceLab 👀👏. So I decided to play around with the hair color feature just to see what it would do… and y’all, I’m kinda impressed 😅

I tried a cooler, more silver/ashy tone and then a warmer blonde, and honestly it gave me a really good idea of what I might actually look like before committing for real (because we all know that hair regret hits FAST 💀).

What I liked:
✔️ Super easy to use
✔️ Gave a realistic preview not perfect, but close enough to help me decide
✔️ Let me compare different tones side-by-side (which is HUGE for indecisive folks like me 🙋‍♀️)

What could be better:
➖ You can tell it’s an app around the roots/edges if you look close
➖ Lighting in the original pic still affects the final look

But overall? It did exactly what I needed it helped me see it before I do it, and that alone saved me from a possible “what did I just do to my hair” moment 😂

Now I gotta ask… which one do y’all like better on me
